mechanism.claim: When Deribit BTC DVOL itself travels unusually violently over a completed day while BTC realized variation is also elevated, the direction of the net implied-volatility repricing identifies risk transfer: rising DVOL maps short BTC and falling DVOL maps long BTC for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the completed 24-hour DVOL close-to-close change
mechanism.why_distinct: Prior DVOL candidates used level crossings, single-hour bodies, BVOL/DVOL disagreement, or ordered handoffs. HVDVVR uses the realized quadratic variation of 24 consecutive DVOL closes as the event and DVOL net change only for direction; no BVOL, OI, funding, premium, or prior event set is used.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both options volatility-of-volatility and BTC realized variation must lie in causal upper tails
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily crypto-options VoV clock is absent from Gross9

features.dvol_source: hash-bound hourly Deribit BTC DVOL snapshot through 2026-08-01
features.decision: each exact 00:00 UTC after 24 completed hourly DVOL bars
features.dvol_window: 24 exact bars with coherent positive OHLC and close_time=bar_start+1h
features.dvol_change: log(last close / close immediately preceding the 24-hour window), strict nonzero
features.dvol_variation: sqrt(sum squared log changes across 25 consecutive closes ending at decision)
features.dvol_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 720 earlier hourly 24h variation states, minimum 336, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed 5m BTC log returns over the same 24 hours)
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 720 earlier hourly 24h states, minimum 336, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: daily nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.no_dvol_variation_gate: DVOL direction and high BTC variation without VoV tail
definitions.no_btc_variation_gate: DVOL VoV tail without BTC variation rank
definitions.dvol_direction: same sign as DVOL change on primary clock
definitions.one_day_stale_dvol: prior exact daily DVOL state with current BTC variation gate

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, window, rank, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
